cohort: The study included 1,124 patients who presented to a tertiary urogynaecology clinic, with 1,012 (90%) being vaginally parous.
finding: There was no significant difference in the prevalence of levator ani muscle avulsion between vaginally primiparous and multiparous women.
mod_finding: Vaginal deliveries after a first vaginal birth are unlikely to cause levator ani muscle avulsion.
followup_time: on average 33 years after their first birth
